## Signal Weekly Briefing

### Executive Summary
The logistics and quick commerce sectors are facing a harsh reality check this week. Capital exhaustion has forced the complete shutdown of pioneer Dunzo, while B2B players like Locus are pivoting away from last-mile delivery to find sustainable enterprise margins.

### Funding Highlights
No new funding rounds were tracked this week.

### Ecosystem Moves
- **Dunzo** (Shutdown): The Bengaluru-based quick commerce startup has officially ceased operations due to an ongoing cash crunch and inability to secure fresh capital.
- **Locus** (Pivot): Shifted its core product strategy from last-mile delivery SaaS to a comprehensive enterprise supply chain intelligence platform.

### Trends to Watch
Last-mile logistics continues to be a graveyard for startup unit economics. Companies surviving the current market are aggressively moving upmarket to enterprise SaaS or exiting consumer delivery entirely.
